## What landed (engineering deliverables)

### 1. Vocabulary + area tiles (data)

- `connectors/src/connectors/data/osm_tag_vocab.toml`
  `2026.10.26` — widened camera-site selection
  (`surveillance:type` + `highway=speed_camera` alongside the
  existing `man_made=surveillance`), the camera-site technology
  map (device-kind × mobility → slug: `alpr-fixed`,
  `alpr-mobile`, `ate-speed`, `face-recognition-unspecified`,
  mobility values `fixed`/`redeployable`/`vehicle_mounted`/
  `airborne`), RF-derived source patterns (Wi-Fi/BLE/RF
  survey), and the mapper-identity key list.
- `connectors/src/connectors/data/osm_area_tiles.toml`
  (`sig.osm-area-tiles/1`, new) — 299 declared areas (50 US
  states + DC selectors, ISO country selectors) and the §4.3
  item-3 parameters: `areas_per_count = 50`,
  `pace_seconds = 30`, `fetch_timeout = 180`,
  `count_timeout = 90`, `count_tolerance_pct = 0.02`,
  `count_tolerance_floor = 2`.

### 2. `osm.py` — the origin (the whole change)

- **Camera-site selection + claim family** — every element
  carrying `surveillance:type` or `highway=speed_camera`
  (node or way; way `center` for geometry) emits the §4.3
  item-1 family: `camera_external_ref = osm:<type>/<id>` +
  candidate identifier `{scheme: "osm.element", value:
  "<type>/<id>"}` (the declared shared namespace, P35.25 —
  republished registry rows carrying the same upstream ref
  resolve at tier 1), `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude`,
  `camera_coordinate_source = osm` (way-centre stated as
  `osm_way_center`), `camera_jurisdiction = sig.unresolved`
  until PKG-06b, `camera_name`/`camera_roadway`/
  `camera_direction` where tagged, `camera_operator` from
  `operator=` through `partner_ref_rows` — **organisations
  only**: a person-shaped value (e.g. `John Smith dba Smith
  Cams`) stays on `operator_stated` and never mints a person
  entity or a `camera_operator` ref.
- **Technology claims through P35.15b's machinery** —
  `technology` emitted from the vocab map; `highway=
  speed_camera` types `ate-speed` (the P36.3 ATE subtype —
  AP-W-024's ≈1,383 US nodes); enforcement relations are not
  emitted (ACQ-03's scope).
- **Mapper-identity stop (SIG-INGEST-045e)** — every widened
  query prints `out body center qt;` — `out meta` is never
  requested, so `user`/`uid` are never asked for — and
  `parse()` refuses (before the capture bytes land) any
  Overpass element still carrying them; scoped to
  `osm_overpass` — `osm_element_history`'s meta-shaped docs
  are not the leak and still process. Edit detection moves to
  `element_content_digest` + `snapshot_content_diff` (version
  optional under `out body`; retained when supplied).
- **Tiled national/global passes** — `out count;` discovery
  per declared area (≤50/count query), then `out body center
  qt;` per non-empty area (`fetch_timeout = 180`,
  `pace_seconds = 30` — the recorded etiquette; ≈70–90
  queries/run on the declared set), `discover_more` resolving
  count results into fetch targets carrying `expected_count`,
  and a `ContentDrift` reconciliation when a fetch's element
  count disagrees with its discovery count (tolerance 2 %,
  floor 2 — SIG-ENG-042, never vacuous).
- **RF-derived coarsening (SIG-PUB-011–014 stand-in)** —
  elements whose `source`/`survey` tags name Wi-Fi/BLE/RF
  detection carry 3-decimal-place coordinates on both the
  claim rows and the `physical_asset` geometry until the
  residential screen lands (publication-side dependency —
  never an ingest blocker).
- Existing behaviour preserved: the OKC bbox target stays one
  target; the existing tag claims (`manufacturer`, `brand`,
  `direction`, `camera:mount`) keep emitting; the canary is
  updated for the `out body` shape.

### 3. Live targets (committed, not executed)

- `connectors/src/connectors/data/live_targets.toml` +
  `live_targets.py` — the OKC bbox query widened to
  `node`/`way`/`relation` with the camera/surveillance
  selectors + `out body center qt`; tile-discovery targets
  with `rate_limit_per_min = 2` (the runner consumes the row's
  budget — `runner.py` target handling; the ≈30 s pacing is the
  recorded `pace_seconds` the fetch schedule honours);
  `SIG_OVERPASS_ENDPOINT` override honoured; default endpoint
  `https://lz4.overpass-api.de/api/interpreter`.

### 4. ER-pool admission

- `resolution/src/resolution/camera_sites_pg.py`
  `_TARGETS_SQL` — additive widening: `osm:%` subject
  identifiers join the `traffic_camera:%` pool. Nothing
  existing is removed; the asset rows keep feeding the ODbL
  `physical_asset` projection.

### 5. Fixtures + tests

- `tests/connectors/fixtures/osm/overpass_body_snapshot.json`
  — an OKC `out body` slice (nodes + ways incl. ALPR,
  `highway=speed_camera`, an RF-derived element, an
  organisation-shaped and a person-shaped operator).
- `tests/connectors/fixtures/osm/overpass_tile_us_ok.json` —
  an ≈200-element Oklahoma-state tile slice.
- `tests/connectors/fixtures/osm/overpass_count_response.json`
  — an `out count` discovery document.
- `tests/connectors/fixtures/osm/overpass_meta_leak.json` —
  a pre-fix meta-shaped response (the refusal + at-rest
  negative control).
- `tests/connectors/test_osm_camera_site.py` — 73 tests:
  emission, technology typing, organisation-only operator,
  RF coarsening, query construction (`out body`, never
  `out meta`), capture-side refusal before bytes land,
  byte-level fresh-capture scan, the committed at-rest screen
  re-run (zero hits on the fresh capture; still counts the
  pre-fix shape), tiling/count reconciliation + drift,
  replay `+0`.
- `tests/resolution/test_osm_origin_er.py` — the
  shadow-diff: 40 camera-registry/OSM record pairs over the
  shared `osm.element` namespace — **39/40 merge (97.5 %,
  tier ≤ 3)**, above the §(6) ≥95 % bar; the single non-merge
  is a deliberate direction conflict that stays `proposed`
  for review — high merge performance never overrides an
  attribute conflict; the undeclared-namespace case proves
  fail-closed shared-upstream evidence.
- `tests/db/test_temporal_contract.py` — DB coverage: `osm:`
  subjects are admitted to the camera-site pool
  (`SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`; ran green on Docker).
- `tests/connectors/test_live_targets.py` pinned assertions
  + `tests/connectors/test_osm.py` updated for the widened
  query shape (the same PR, per the contract).
